# V7 Labs

> > V7 Go is an AI agent platform that automates complex workflows in finance, legal, real estate, and insurance through pre-built agents and deep third-party integrations.

V7 Labs provides an AI agent platform called V7 Go with 300+ pre-built tools and agents designed for enterprise automation. The platform specializes in finance (FP&A, deal analysis), legal (contract management, bill auditing), real estate (entitlement tracking), and insurance workflows, with integrations to industry-standard tools like Bloomberg, DealCloud, Yardi, and Microsoft Office.

## Key Topics

- V7 Go
- AI agents
- Workflow automation
- Finance automation
- Legal tech
- Deal screening
- Document processing
- Contract management
- Real estate automation
- Insurance automation
- Agentic AI
- Integration platforms
- Enterprise automation
- AI-powered document analysis

## Core Platform

- [V7 Go | AI Agent Platform for Finance, Legal & Insurance](https://www.v7labs.com): V7 Go AI agent platform for automating complex work in finance, legal, and insurance.
- [AI Agent Library | 300+ Tools for Finance, Real Estate & Ops](https://www.v7labs.com/agents): Pre-built AI agent library with 300+ tools for finance, real estate, and operations automation.

## Finance & Deal Automation Agents

- [AI FP&A Automation Agent | Automate Financial Planning | V7 Go](https://www.v7labs.com/agents/fpa-automation-agent): FP&A automation agent for financial planning, forecasting, and variance analysis workflows.
- [Deal Agreement Analysis Agent | Automate Covenant Extraction | V7 Go](https://www.v7labs.com/agents/deal-agreement-analysis-agent): AI agent for automating covenant extraction from credit agreements and deal documents.
- [AI LPA Analysis Agent | Automate Limited Partnership Agreement Review](https://www.v7labs.com/agents/ai-lpa-analysis-agent): AI agent for analyzing Limited Partnership Agreements and extracting fund management terms.

## Legal & Contract Management Agents

- [AI Legal Bill Audit Agent | Automate Outside Counsel Review | V7 Go](https://www.v7labs.com/agents/ai-agent-for-legal-bill-auditors): AI agent for automating legal invoice review and outside counsel billing compliance.
- [AI Contract Manager Agent | Track Renewals & Control Spend | V7 Go](https://www.v7labs.com/agents/ai-agent-for-contract-managers): Contract manager agent for tracking renewals, vendor agreements, and spend control.

## Real Estate & Operations Agents

- [AI Real Estate Development Agent | Automate Entitlement Tracking](https://www.v7labs.com/agents/ai-agent-for-real-estate-development-managers): Real estate agent for automating entitlement tracking, zoning permits, and compliance monitoring.

## Enterprise Integrations

- [Integrations Library | Connect Your Tools and Automate with AI Agents](https://www.v7labs.com/integrations): Integrations library connecting V7 Go AI agents to third-party tools and platforms.
- [Bloomberg Integration Hub | Automate Valuation and Financial Modeling](https://www.v7labs.com/integrations/bloomberg): Bloomberg integration for automating DCF modeling and financial valuation workflows.
- [DealCloud Integration Hub | Automate Deal Screening and Pipeline Management](https://www.v7labs.com/integrations/dealcloud): DealCloud integration for automating deal screening, CIM analysis, and PE/VC pipeline management.
- [PitchBook Integration Hub | Automate Investment Analysis and Deal Evaluation](https://www.v7labs.com/integrations/pitchbook): PitchBook integration for automating investment analysis and deal screening workflows.
- [Yardi Integration Hub | Automate Real Estate Lease and Property Management](https://www.v7labs.com/integrations/yardi): Yardi integration hub for real estate lease abstraction, rent-roll parsing, and property automation.

## Communication & Collaboration Integrations

- [Gmail Integration Hub | Automate Email Workflows with AI](https://www.v7labs.com/integrations/gmail): Gmail integration for automating email management, routing, and communication workflows.
- [Microsoft Outlook Integration Hub | Automate Email and Contact Management](https://www.v7labs.com/integrations/microsoft-outlook): Outlook integration for automating email management, contact organization, and message workflows.
- [Microsoft Teams Integration Hub | Automate Team Communication with AI](https://www.v7labs.com/integrations/microsoft-teams): Teams integration for automating channel management, message routing, and team collaboration.
- [SharePoint Integration Hub | Automate Document Management with AI](https://www.v7labs.com/integrations/sharepoint): SharePoint integration for automating document management and team collaboration workflows.
- [Plain Integration Hub | Automate Customer Support Workflows](https://www.v7labs.com/integrations/plain): Plain integration for automating customer support ticket routing and communication workflows.
